profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Electrical Engineer by education, Software Engineer by vocation with 20+ years of experience in roles of increasing responsibility in Quality Assurance, Application Engineering, GUI Design, Middleware/Embedded systems Integration and Full Stack Deployment. Uniquely positioned to deliver a holistic approach to software architecture and development with a focus on designing efficient systems and platforms and building effective teams. 

Key Values:
Sharing ideas and working as a Team toward a common goal excite me.
Continuous improvement, whether it be technical, professional or personal, drives me.
Being a change agent and champion in our community for all people, fulfills me.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Expanding technical leadership in autonomous tractor trailer control specifically in behaviors and perception. Establishing best practices and quality coding principles across ever growing teams. Evangelizing safety, maintainability, and repeatability to reach our goal of Level 4 autonomy in the trucking industry.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architecting large systems across multiple teams. Driving business decisions and practices with a strong technical foundation. Realizing business revenue through direct customer engagement. Establishing engineering practices and guidelines for the teams. Mentoring team members to reach their full potential.
- Delivered the all new OT data collection and Asset content management platform focusing on OPC Edge devices and APM Health, Reliability, and Strategy modules.

positions.title: Technical Team Lead
positions.description: Continuing growth in our Software Design team members while expanding our experience in microservice architecture and the GE Predix Platform. Transforming legacy data collection adapters into Predix-based services with unyielding commitment to customer base.

positions.title: Technical Team Lead
positions.description: Adding value and generating revenue by leading a small team to deliver best-in-class data collection adapters to Smart Sensor technology from GE, Emerson, and others. Building new software architectures and design patterns implemented by the rest of the team. Evangelizing eXtreme Programming principles and design practices, being a champion of Agile Methodologies, and mentoring the team throughout their careers.

positions.title: Lead Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: In addition to software design roles, managed project level execution including: developing resource plans and task lists, monitoring budgets, holding reviews of design concepts with Chief Engineers, updating project status with Engineering Management, communicating issues directly with customers, and driving project to completion.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Applied previous GUI software design experience to low-level embedded systems expanding expertise in high-availability architecture and mission-critical processes. Diagnosed customer control installation issues at domestic and international sites while providing technical training and support for the newest GE turbine control platform.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description: Gathered requirements, produced detailed design specifications, implemented design in development environment(s), devised unit and system test cases, and completed technical documentation.
